curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Hawk enters the championship with everything on the line, but outlasting the heavyweight competition is only half the battle in reclaiming his family.
curatedMovie.description: Big-rig trucker Lincoln Hawk enters the World Armwrestling Championship in Las Vegas, hoping to rebuild his life.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting 1980s sports drama with sincere emotional warmth and accessible, low-friction stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action drama joins the championship contest with Hawk’s effort to reconnect with the son he left years earlier.
